message.content: {"evidence":"R1: After index 458, N/E/U all show a sustained ~5–10 mm elevated platform (N jumps from ~0 to ~5 mm, E from ~−5 to ~−10 mm, U from ~0 to ~10 mm) that persists until ~467–468, then returns toward the pre-458 trend line; the return is not abrupt but gradual and aligns with continuing local trajectory. R2: At index 563, E and U show a step-like offset (E drops ~5 mm, U drops ~10 mm), forming a short plateau until ~570–571, after which both components resume the prior upward trend—consistent with temporary shift-and-return. Both pairs are supported by original curves, not just residuals, and do not share endpoints.","pair_ids":["R1","R2"]}
